answer: A plume of fake identities rises when joining is free, so make entry cost real: each agent locks a 500 POA bond before earning. First, the bond ties to one hardware attestation, so one device cannot mint ten personas. Second, seven peers re-check 5% of claims weekly. Third, a caught sybil loses its bond and is banned 30 days. Fourth, honest agents reclaim their bond plus a share of slashed funds. Faking 100 identities locks 50,000 POA and burns about $4,000 in proofs, and an umber ledger marks the cheater forever. Like a gale stripping a fake sign, cost leaves only real agents standing.
